examples.japanese: {川岸|かわぎし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}った→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: I sat down on the riverbank.

examples.japanese: {川岸|かわぎし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Cherry trees are lined up along the riverbank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{川岸|かわぎし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げて→投げる：01135_nageru⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいた→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children were playing on the riverbank, throwing stones.

notes:
Refers to the edge or bank of a river. A straightforward compound of ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧ (river) and ⟦{岸|きし}→岸：02545_kishi⟧ (shore/bank), with the second element voiced ({岸|ぎし}) due to rendaku.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {川岸|かわぎし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand on the riverbank
- {川岸|かわぎし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk along the riverbank
- {川岸|かわぎし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧: grass on the riverbank

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {河岸|かし}: riverbank — also read かし, often refers to a wharf or fish market (as in {河岸|かし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧, to move to a different bar/restaurant)
- ⟦{川辺|かわべ}→川辺：20224_kawabe⟧: riverside — emphasizes the area near the river rather than the bank itself
- ⟦{岸辺|きしべ}→岸辺：20225_kishibe⟧: shore, waterside — can refer to any body of water, not just rivers
